title: Dedalo project status
description: Output of `dedalo status --json`: what is pending, what the rules are, and what has been settled. The obvious thing for a bot to poll.

lands_as.description: How a change is recognised on this branch. `commits` is what a squash-merge repository needs, and getting it wrong changes what everybody is paid.

pending_changes.description: Changes landed since the last settled round. Named `changes` rather than `merges` because on a squash-merge repository they are not merge commits.

contributor_bps.description: Derived — whatever the other two leave. Emitted anyway, because a consumer computing it would be a second implementation of the one subtraction that decides how much contributors get.

state.description: What the ledger records. Every field is null until a round has been settled — a project that has never paid anybody says so rather than reporting zeroes that look like a settled round of nothing.
